routes.reviewNote: Issuer-native deployment: the same Nest BoringVault is deployed on ethereum with owner() = the Nest 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 (on-chain read 2026-07-20); shares mint only through Nest's own Teller contract. No third-party bridge mints this deployment.

Issuer-native deployment: the same Nest BoringVault is deployed on Plume with owner() = the Nest 3-of-6 Safe 0xa08a0dc480bd60d1d56c8eec6c722125eafea982 (on-chain read 2026-07-20). Cross-chain share movement between Plume and Ethereum runs through Nest's own LayerZero OFT contracts (NestVaultOFT/NestShareOFT hub-and-spoke per the nest-protocol repository and Nest cross-chain docs) — an issuer-operated burn/mint, not a third-party bridge; the share token itself is not the LayerZero OApp.
